Results.ReviewText:
Perfect size for two people in a townehouse. Easy to move from garage to patio.
Excellent heat distrubution. One burner set at 1/4 open maintains 350F. Fast recovery makes it perfect for baking. (No more meatloaf spatters in our indoor range.)
A single exit for drippings makes keeping it clean a breeze. Just wipe down with a paper towel or two.
Assembly was fun. About two hours total time.
My only complaint is the two burner does not have a natural gas option.
Results.Title: The last grill you will ever buy!

Results.ReviewText: My 1st owned Weber and words cannot describe how I love and enjoy to grill on it. This 2 gas burner is big enough for a whole family…temperature controls are perfect, specially when cooking red meats. Seals meats to perfection. The way it lights up (not right on the center, but on all the 4 corners if it, prevents meats from burning). Bought the Weber cooking spray which makes it so easy to clean. It is worth spending a little more on this grill than buying cheaper ones if you enjoy grilling to perfection. Even the sealing marks is beautiful. I am now a Weber fan, a tweeter follower for great recipes and would recommend this a 100% without any doubt!
Results.Title: Weber Spirit II E-210

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
